en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding song. 'Дружба' in 'писмо од дружба' is my reading: a letter from a companion/friend (possibly the sweetheart).

lines.cyr: Рајна на порти стоеше, мила мамо,
lines.lat: Rajna na porti stoeše, mila mamo,
lines.en: Rajna stood at the gate, dear mother,

lines.cyr: Оздола иде млад јунак, мила мамо,
lines.lat: Ozdola ide mlad junak, mila mamo,
lines.en: From below comes a young lad, dear mother,
from below comes a young lad,
and he brings a letter for Rajna.

lines.cyr: - Рајно ле, моме убаво, леле убаво,
lines.lat: - Rajno le, mome ubavo, lele ubavo,
lines.en: - Oh Rajna, beautiful girl, oh beautiful,
I bring you a letter from your companion.

lines.cyr: Рајна на јунак думаше, леле думаше,
lines.lat: Rajna na junak dumaše, lele dumaše,
lines.en: Rajna spoke to the lad, oh she spoke,

lines.cyr: - Што ќе ми писмо од дружба,
lines.lat: - Što ḱe mi pismo od družba,
lines.en: - What do I want with a letter from my companion,
when my sweetheart has gone away?
